auth.label: Jackett address (usually port 9117)
auth.help: Where your own Jackett runs, as host or host:port over plain http with no URL base, such as 192.168.1.10:9117, with 1337x added as an indexer. 1337x answers with a Cloudflare challenge, so Jackett needs FlareSolverr set up to reach it.

auth.label: Jackett API key
auth.help: Copy the API Key shown at the top of Jackett's dashboard.
